title: Venezuelan-Style Chicken Noodle Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic one-pot meal made with chicken, noodles, and pilaf, inspired by Venezuelan cuisine.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the pilaf mix, cumin, and paprika. Stir well to combine.
Add the noodles and chicken broth (according to package instructions). Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the noodles and chicken are cooked through.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
